The authz check explicitly permits non-organizers (attendee, team admin/owner), so `updateCalendarAttendees` would use the wrong user's calendar credentials when invoked by them. adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the handler builds the `EventManager` using the caller (`ctx.user`): it calls `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` and constructs `new EventManager({ ...user, credentials: [...] })`. However, the booking organizer is `booking.userId` (and `booking.user` is fetched with `credentials: true` but never used). Because the authz permits non-organizers (`isAttendee` or team admin/owner) to call this mutation, a non-organizer can trigger `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` using their own credentials instead of the organizer’s, which can leave the organizer’s calendar event not updated (or update the wrong account).
